question: How much will Nasdaq-100 Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 23 - Dec 4)

calls.reasoning: Base P0 = Nov 20 closes after a crash week (SPX -8.6%, NDX -10.4%; Friday NDX -5.6% vs SPX -3.7%; VIX 35.9) driven by an AI/semis selloff and SEC scrutiny of Nvidia. NQ-ES spread over 9 sessions is roughly (beta-1)*market return plus semis-driven idiosyncratic noise, so it is mostly a bet on market direction. Prior: centered near +0.1 (long-run small NQ drift). Adjustments: slight post-crash rebound tendency plus IG weekend US Tech 100 +1.44% tilt the median up modestly to +0.25; the weekend quote is discounted as noisy. Dispersion is sized to the stressed regime (SD ~2pp), with small tail mass beyond ±5pp for a renewed chip collapse or a violent short-covering rally. No human market prices this spread (none on Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi).
